title: PRC Regulations on Foreign Exchange Administration (State Council Order 532, 2008)
quote: 第三十九条 ... 处逃汇金额30%以下的罚款；情节严重的，处逃汇金额30%以上等值以下的罚款
note: Arts. 5, 12, 39, 40, 45, 52 read and transcribed. Penalty bands are ceilings, not predictions.

title: Measures for the Administration of Individual Foreign Exchange (PBOC Decree [2006] No.3)
quote: 第三条 经常项目项下的个人外汇业务按照可兑换原则管理，资本项目项下的个人外汇业务按照可兑换进程管理
note: Arts. 2, 3, 7, 9, 13, 14, 22, 26, 28, 33-37 read; Art. 37 defines 境内个人 / 境外个人.

title: Current Account Foreign Exchange Business Guidelines (2020), Huifa [2020] No.14
quote: 第五十四条 个人结汇和境内个人购汇实行年度便利化额度管理，便利化额度分别为每人每年等值5万美元
note: Chapter 3 Arts. 54-65, Chapter 4 Arts. 86-88 read from the official gazette text. Art. 56 permits non-quota current-account purchase with purpose documents; Art. 59 covers overseas individuals' lawful China-source RMB income; Art. 64 sets a USD 50,000/day remittance threshold; Art. 65 covers overseas individuals' outward remittance.

title: 2026 individual FX Q&A (07): does studying abroad consume the convenience quota?
quote: 个人可以自主选择是否占用本人便利化额度 ... 如不占用本人便利化额度，则需凭本人有效身份证件和有交易额的购汇资金用途相关材料
note: Confirms the USD 50,000 quota is a convenience tier, not an absolute ceiling, for genuine current-account purposes.

title: 2026 individual FX Q&A (03): is there a quota on outward remittance for current-account spending?
quote: 外汇账户内外汇汇出境外当日累计等值5万美元以下（含）的，凭本人有效身份证件办理；超过上述金额的，凭本人有效身份证件、有交易额的相关材料办理
note: USD 50,000/day (not per year) threshold for remitting FX already held; above it, documents.

title: 2026 individual FX Q&A (08): how does an overseas individual remit China-source labour remuneration?
quote: 境外个人在境内取得的经常项目合法人民币收入，凭本人有效身份证件和有交易额的购汇资金来源材料（含税务凭证）在银行办理购汇
note: 2026 restatement of Art. 59; tax vouchers are documentation, not a conversion tax.

title: SAFE Circular Huifa [2014] No.2 — capital-account policy adjustments (amended)
quote: 六、简化个人财产转移售付汇管理 ... （二）取消移民财产转移分次汇出的要求
note: Section VI cancels the 2004 staged-release requirement, the >CNY 500,000 SAFE head-office filing, separate applications for different decedents, and notarisation. Page is marked 已修改; the footnote's amendment concerns Section III (ODI preliminary expenses), not Section VI.

title: SAFE English translation of Huifa [2014] No.2
quote: The English translation may only be used as a reference. In case of a different interpretation ... the original Chinese shall prevail
note: English is a reference translation only; the Chinese text governs.

title: Interim Measures for FX Settlement and Payment for Individual Property Transfers (PBOC Announcement [2004] No.16)
quote: 第六条 移民转移必须一次性申请拟转移出境的全部财产金额，分步汇出 ... 第十一条 外汇指定银行办理售汇后，应直接将外汇汇往 ... 申请人本人的账户
note: Art. 6 staged release is SUPERSEDED by CN-CAP-2014 §VI(2). Art. 8 requires hukou cancellation, foreign-settlement certificate, property-title and tax-clearance documents. Art. 10's >CNY 500,000 head-office approval is also superseded. Art. 11 direct remittance to the applicant's own account remains.

issuer: Shanghai Municipal Government (source: Bank of China)
title: FAQ: can I buy foreign exchange using the proceeds from selling my house?
quote: Step 3. Visit the local tax authority to settle the tax on the proceeds from the sale of the house property and obtain the proof of tax payment
note: Tax voucher and, above USD 50,000, a Tax Filing Form for External Payments are required before purchase/remittance.

title: Individual Income Tax Law of the PRC (2018 amendment)
quote: Article 2 The following categories of individual income shall be subject to individual income tax ... (6) Income from interest, dividends or bonuses ... (8) Income from transfer of assets
note: Art. 2 lists the nine taxable categories; converting one's own principal is not listed. Art. 3 sets a 20% flat rate for interest/dividends, asset transfers, leasing and incidental income.

title: Caishui [2008] No.132 — IIT on interest from savings deposits
quote: 自2008年10月9日起，对储蓄存款利息所得暂免征收个人所得税
note: Interest accruing on savings deposits from 2008-10-09 is temporarily exempt from PRC IIT. Other interest remains taxable at 20% under the IIT Law.

title: MOF/STA Announcement 2026 No.27 — IIT on dividends received by foreign individuals
quote: 一、外籍个人从外商投资企业取得的股息红利所得，按照“利息、股息、红利所得”缴纳个人所得税，适用20%税率
note: Effective 2026-09-01; repeals the 1994 exemption in Caishui [1994] No.20 Art. 2(8). Relevant only if the stuck CNY came from FIE dividends.

title: STA/SAFE Announcement 2013 No.40 — tax filing for external payments (amended)
quote: 一、境内机构和个人向境外单笔支付等值5万美元以上（不含等值5万美元）下列外汇资金 ... 均应向所在地主管税务机关进行税务备案
note: Art. 3(13) exempts 境内个人境外留学、旅游、探亲等因私用汇. The page's annotation states that 2021 No.19 repealed Art. 1(2), Art. 2(2), Arts. 5-8, Art. 10 and Annex 2. A tax filing is a reporting step, not a tax.

title: STA/SAFE Announcement 2021 No.19 — supplementary announcement on tax filing
quote: 一、境内机构和个人对同一笔合同需要多次对外支付的，仅需在首次付汇前办理税务备案
note: Online/one-time filing; confirms which 2013 provisions were repealed.

title: SAFE explainer of Huifa [2017] No.29 — overseas ATM cash withdrawals
quote: 本人名下银行卡（含附属卡）合计每个自然年度不得超过等值10万元人民币；将人民币卡、外币卡境外提取现金每卡每日额度统一为等值1万元人民币
note: Effective 2018-01-01. Also states normal card consumption and the USD 50,000 convenience quota are unaffected.

title: GACC Q&A: how much cash may be taken out of China?
quote: 每人每次携带现金的限额是人民币20000元，外币5000美元
note: Official customs consultation answer dated 2021-03-12. Larger amounts require a 携带外汇出境许可证; the Changsha Customs Q&A URL used in earlier editions returned HTTP 404 on retrieval.

title: GACC service guide — supervision of inbound/outbound passenger baggage
quote: 进出境旅客携带有应向海关申报物品的，应选择“申报通道”（又称“红色通道”）通关
note: Confirms the red-channel written declaration procedure; no fee is charged.

title: NIA Q&A citing Nationality Law Art. 9
quote: 定居外国的中国公民，自愿加入或取得外国国籍的，即自动丧失中国国籍
note: An un-cancelled hukou / PRC ID does not preserve Chinese nationality, but it can cause the bank to classify the account as 境内个人.

title: Yinfa [2021] No.237 — further prevention of virtual-currency trading risks
quote: 虚拟货币相关业务活动属于非法金融活动 ... 一律严格禁止，坚决依法取缔
note: Fiat-to-virtual-currency exchange and offshore exchanges serving mainland residents are prohibited. No execution steps are published for this route.

note: Items 2.2.4.1/2.2.4.2. Free only for Private Banking individual customers; Premier/Advance pay 0.1% (min CNY100, max CNY500) + CNY120 cable. 'Pay Exact' is CNY200. The PDF also contains an embedded older table headed 2024年9月12日生效 — mixed vintage is flagged.

note: Only to an account in the sender's own name; bank-app single transfer maximum CNY 300,000; overall limit based on China salary after China tax, evidenced by tax records; Wise works with a PBOC-licensed third-party payment provider.

title: Chase Additional Banking Services and Fees for Personal Accounts
quote: Domestic and International Incoming Wire ... $15 per transfer OR $0 if the transfer was originally sent with the help of a Chase banker or using chase.com or Chase Mobile
note: USD 15 per incoming international wire for personal accounts; the $0 branch applies to transfers originated at Chase, not a BOC-originated wire. Fees may be waived for some account types. Provider-specific, not universal.

title: IRS — Report of Foreign Bank and Financial Accounts (FBAR)
quote: the aggregate value of those foreign financial accounts exceeded $10,000 at any time during the calendar year reported
note: Both chunks of the page were read on 2026-11-09. US citizens must file FinCEN Form 114; due April 15 with automatic extension to October 15; records retained five years; civil maxima adjusted annually for inflation; e-file with FinCEN, not with the tax return.

title: IRS — comparison of Form 8938 and FBAR requirements
quote: Up to $10,000 for failure to disclose and an additional $10,000 for each 30 days of non-filing after IRS notice ... potential maximum penalty of $60,000
note: Form 8938 thresholds: US-resident unmarried >USD 50,000 on last day / >USD 75,000 during year; MFJ >USD 100,000 / >USD 150,000; abroad thresholds are higher. FBAR threshold USD 10,000 aggregate.

title: 31 U.S.C. §5321 — civil penalties (2024 edition)
quote: the maximum penalty ... shall be increased to the greater of (I) $100,000, or (II) 50 percent of the amount determined under subparagraph (D)
note: 31 USC 5321(a)(5)(C): willful FBAR penalty is the greater of USD 100,000 or 50% of the account balance at the time of violation; (a)(5)(B) sets USD 10,000 for non-willful, with a reasonable-cause exception.

title: 31 CFR §1010.821 — penalty adjustment table
quote: Foreign Financial Agency Transaction—Non-Willful Violation of Transaction ... $16,536; ... Willful Violation of Transaction ... $165,353
note: Table displayed for penalties assessed on or after January 17, 2025; eCFR page was current through 2026-11-05 on retrieval. Statutory USD 100,000 floor is adjusted to USD 165,353; non-willful USD 10,000 to USD 16,536. These are maxima, not predicted assessments.

title: 26 U.S.C. §988 — treatment of certain foreign currency transactions (2024 edition)
quote: no gain shall be recognized ... The preceding sentence shall not apply if the gain which would otherwise be recognized on the transaction exceeds $200
note: §988(e): personal transactions are excluded; no gain recognised on exchange-rate changes for an individual's personal transaction unless the gain exceeds USD 200. §988(c)(1)(C) treats disposition of nonfunctional currency as a §988 transaction.

title: IRS — foreign currency and currency exchange rates
quote: You must express the amounts you report on your U.S. tax return in U.S. dollars ... Use the exchange rate prevailing when you receive, pay, or accrue the item
note: Reporting currency rule; not a tax on moving one's own principal.

title: IRS — U.S. citizens and resident aliens abroad
quote: You are subject to tax on worldwide income from all sources and must report all taxable income
note: Interest earned on the CNY deposit is US-taxable even while the money sits in China. Also states Form 3520 is required for gifts/bequests >USD 100,000 from a nonresident alien or foreign estate.

title: IRS — foreign tax credit
quote: If you paid or accrued foreign taxes to a foreign country ... and are subject to U.S. tax on the same income, you may be able to take either a credit or an itemized deduction
note: Form 1116; generally only income, war profits and excess profits taxes qualify; no credit for tax on excluded income.

title: IRS — gifts from foreign person
quote: the aggregate amount received ... exceeds $100,000 during the taxable year
note: Form 3520 Part IV threshold for gifts/bequests from a nonresident alien or foreign estate; 2026 threshold for foreign corporations/partnerships is USD 20,573. Reporting only — a foreign gift is generally excluded from gross income.

title: IRS — Instructions for Form 3520 (12/2025)
quote: Section 6677 ... Section 6039F
note: Penalty sections for failure to file Form 3520; the percentage amounts were not transcribed from the retrieved chunk and are left blank.

title: IRS — streamlined filing compliance procedures
quote: Taxpayers must certify that conduct was not willful
note: Available to individual taxpayers who certify non-willful conduct; resolves delinquent returns and FBARs. Not available once a civil examination has begun.

title: IR-2026-48 — proposed regulations on the 1% remittance transfer tax
quote: Beginning Jan. 1, 2026, a 1% remittance transfer tax applies to remittances sent from the United States to recipients in foreign countries when the sender provides cash, a money order, a cashier's check, or other similar physical instrument
note: A China→US transfer is not a remittance sent FROM the United States; a bank-to-bank wire funded from a deposit is not a physical instrument. The tax therefore does not apply to the routes in this dossier.

title: IRS — Working Families Tax Cuts, 'Other taxes' section
quote: Beginning Jan. 1, 2026 ... Collect the 1% excise tax on applicable remittance transactions when the sender pays with cash, a money order, a cashier's check, or a similar physical instrument
note: Canonical URL fetched directly on 2026-11-09; chunk 4, 'Excise tax on certain remittance transfers (Section 70604)', confirms the 1% tax and the physical-instrument funding condition. Official overview of section 70604 / IRC §4475.

title: CBP — currency reporting reminder (Dulles seizures)
quote: federal law ... requires travelers to report all currency and monetary instruments of $10,000 or greater to a CBP officer
note: No limit on the amount, but FinCEN 105 is required at USD 10,000 or more; CBP states unreported currency risks seizure and criminal prosecution. There is no tax on declaring.
